oauth2Ping.description: To use the BSCA interoperability API OAuth 2.0,developer must register their application. A registered application is given a client ID and a client secret. The secret should only be used if it can be kept confidential, such as communication between your server and the BSCA interoperability APIs.                                                  Access tokens have scopes, which define permissions and the resources that the token can access. Scopes are primarily utilized to determine the type of data an application is requesting. Scopes must be explicitly declared; wildcards are not supported.
